description: Remove a rule from the workspace library permanently. This detaches it from every project holding it, so prefer `update_workspace_guideline` with `enabled: false` when the rule may come back.

guideline_id.description: Library guideline UUID: the `id` from list_workspace_guidelines or list_project_guidelines (not the `attachment_id`).

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: remove_workspace_guideline

removed.description: UUID of the guideline that was removed.

title: Remove workspace guideline
